playwright.title: Playwright
playwright.purpose: Browser walks for web QA evidence (screenshots, DOM checks).
playwright.without: A change that touches web UI cannot get a browser walk, so it is blocked for a person to check; changes without UI are unaffected.

maestro.title: Maestro
maestro.purpose: Mobile UI flows on a simulator or emulator.
maestro.without: A change that touches the mobile app cannot get a device walk, so it is blocked for a person to check; changes without UI are unaffected.

context7.title: Context7
context7.purpose: Current library documentation for the builder and reviewers.
context7.without: Agents rely on the repository's own docs and on WebFetch.

github.title: GitHub
github.purpose: Read issues, pull requests, reviews and Actions runs.
requires: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN exported in the shell that starts claude (read scopes are enough)
github.without: Agents read GitHub through the gh CLI, which the factory needs anyway.

21st.title: 21st.dev Magic
21st.purpose: UI component inspiration for frontend tickets.
21st.without: UI work follows the repository's own components and brand rules.

sequential-thinking.title: Sequential Thinking
sequential-thinking.purpose: Structured step-by-step reasoning for hard problems.
sequential-thinking.without: Agents reason in their own context.

atlassian.title: Atlassian (Jira)
atlassian.purpose: Read and write Jira issues for tasks.source = jira.
requires: OAuth login once: run /mcp in claude
atlassian.without: Choose another tasks.source (local, github or notion).

jira.title: Jira (API token)
jira.purpose: Read and write Jira issues on an API token, which also works in an unattended pass.
jira.without: Choose another tasks.source (local, github or notion), or use the Atlassian server and log in with /mcp.

notion.title: Notion
notion.purpose: Read and write Notion pages for tasks.source = notion.
requires: OAuth login once: run /mcp in claude
notion.without: Choose another tasks.source (local, github or jira).

sentry.title: Sentry
sentry.purpose: Read-only error telemetry for bug triage and post-merge validation.
requires: OAuth login once: run /mcp in claude
sentry.without: Bugs are triaged from the ticket text and a reproduction; post-merge validation is skipped.

axiom.title: Axiom
axiom.purpose: Read-only log telemetry for bug triage and post-merge validation.
requires: OAuth login once: run /mcp in claude
axiom.without: Bugs are triaged from the ticket text and a reproduction; post-merge validation is skipped.
